summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: foreign private issuer current report) disclosing open-market purchases of its own shares under Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 buyback regime. On 10/14/2026, CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$2,085.24 (AR$250,229,901 total), while wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 underlying shares) on NYSE at US$12.96 average (US$388,903.48). Daily purchases stayed under 25% of the 90-business-day average daily trading volume, so no tender mechanics, premium, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. Watch future buyback pace and share cancellation versus treasury holding.
